items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: here's Zooty and the guys down there, you know, at the Eagles, uh, on, uh, on, uh, on the piano player, Boogie Whirer piano player

ctx.x: You mean the Blackhawk? Not the Blackhawk?

No, no, I'm talking of the north side, way uptown, uptown around, uh, Well, don't worry. Well, anyway, we lived up that way, see, so by the time we, we, we, get, get in our cars and go home, it's about three o'clock in the morning and so forth. And, my wife didn't come down to Woodbury all the time and she was all alone in, in this hotel room. And I used to try and get, get home as fast as I could, you know. Mm-hmm. But sometimes I, I would go down, uh, with the guys and I'd call her up and say, Well, we're going…
